department_value_ids.description: For an invitation that gives the Approver role: the department values to narrow it to (FR-ADM-01, rev 0.253), fixed from the first minute. Appendix D's department-qualified cells then reach only the records, lines and budgets of these values; an Approver role given with none reaches none of them. Another set of roles is refused.

display_name.description: The name of the person you invite.

email.description: Where to tell the person they were invited (FR-ADM-01, rev 0.421): an email that names the organisation and says to ask for the one-time code, which is never in the email. It is not kept: it is used to send that one message.

items.description: A role of PRD-001 §7.1, such as owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

roles_expire_at.description: For an external user, such as an auditor: when their roles end. Never on the Owner role.
